title: 2006 AMC 8 Problem 20
statement: A singles tournament had six players. Each player played every other player only once, with no ties. If Helen won \(4\) games, Ines won \(3\) games, Janet won \(2\) games, Kendra won \(2\) games and Lara won \(2\) games, how many games did Monica win?

solutions.text:
In every match, there was exactly one winner. There are \(6 \cdot 5 \div 2 = 15\) games and therefore \(15\) wins.

There are already \[ 4 + 3 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 13 \] wins accounted for, so Monica won \(15 - 13 = 2\) games.

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Count how many games are played in a six-player round robin.
Every game has exactly one winner, so total wins equal total games.
